stem.en: A child on a merry-go-round goes round a circle of radius 4 m in 8 s, at constant speed. What is the child's average speed over one round, in m/s? Use π = 3.14.

explanation.en: In one round the child travels the circumference, 2πR = 2 x 3.14 x 4 m = 25.12 m. Average speed = 25.12 m / 8 s = 3.14 m/s. The average velocity over the round is zero, because the child is back at the start.

hints.en: Distance in one round = 2πR. Divide it by the time for one round.
